product_one_liner.value: Aikido provides a developer-first security platform that helps developers and security teams detect, prioritize, and remediate risks across code, cloud, and runtime.
product_one_liner.notes: Aikido's press kit describes its developer-first security products and says its platform secures code, cloud, and runtime to help teams reduce risk.

pricing_page.notes: Aikido has a public pricing page showing a Developer plan and its pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company press kit names Revolut and SoundCloud among Aikido's global customers. | named_customers.0: Aikido's press kit names Revolut as a customer. | named_customers.1: Aikido's press kit names SoundCloud as a customer.

employee_band.notes: Aikido's LinkedIn company profile reports a company size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Aikido's About page lists its address in Ghent; the company profile also identifies Ghent as headquarters. | hq_country: Aikido's About page identifies Belgium; its Ghent headquarters is corroborated by the company's press kit.

founded_year.notes: Aikido's company source states that it was founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The Altar post is by Selim Decamps, identified on his profile as Aikido Machine Lead Engineer, and details model-compression implementation. The Opengrep post is by its maintainer Dimitris Mostrous and describes substantive architectural and implementation work, including an OCaml 5 migration and shared-memory parallelism. Together these support a technical blog with at least two build-focused posts; confidence is medium because the second author is identified as a maintainer rather than given an explicit engineering job title.

public_docs.notes: Aikido provides a public documentation site with multiple sections, including scanning capabilities and developer integrations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Aikido's careers postings include an AI Engineer role and a Software Engineer role on its AI Pentest team.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; and Aikido Altar, built from GLM-5.3.
model_provider.notes: Aikido's subprocessors page names OpenAI for AI inference; its AutoFix documentation says models are hosted on AWS Bedrock; and its Altar post says the model was built from GLM-5.3.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Aikido's trust page explicitly says it is ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II compliant, and separately says it complies with GDPR. FedRAMP is excluded because the page describes it as actively being implemented, not completed. | compliance_certs.0: The trust page explicitly claims ISO 27001:2022 compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The same trust-page statement explicitly claims AICPA SOC 2 Type II compliance. | compliance_certs.2: The trust page explicitly states compliance with GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The January 2026 announcement identifies the round as Series B. | funding_date: The announcement date is January 14, 2026, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-01. | funding_amount_usd: Aikido's funding announcement identifies a $60 million Series B, dated January 14, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: Aikido announced its $60 million Series B in January 2026, which falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Aikido's careers pages list an Account Executive Enterprise opening with responsibilities described in the posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Aikido announced its new open-weight Altar security model on September 21, 2026, inside the six-month window before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile records Jeff Poczatek as VP Sales Commercial US at Aikido, with a start date of 2026-02-01, within the 12 months before 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Aikido's HubSpot CRM Manager job posting says the role will own and operate the company's HubSpot instance. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting explicitly says the company uses HubSpot.
